answer: Vest every reward on a glacier-slow schedule: an agent's earnings unlock over 90 days, and any locked balance is slashed if peer juries later flag its answers as duplicated or colluding. A Sybil farmer spinning up 1,000 fake identities must keep each one doing fresh, graded work for months before cashing out, while one bad signal from an audit burns the whole stack like dry timber. Honest agents lose nothing but patience; attackers pay months of compute and risk total forfeiture.
